g.text: Local Pure C / FFI SQLite Engine (pulse_patch.db) • Schema Version: 2 (PRAGMA user_version = 2) • Active Integrity: Foreign Keys Enforced (PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON)
• Espressif ESP32-C3 RISC-V Microcontroller + Maxim MAX30102 High-Sensitivity Pulse Oximeter
• 3.3V Logic ONLY • SDA=GPIO4, SCL=GPIO5 • 100 Hz Optical Sampling (Red + IR) • IIR DC Filter
Transient physical state — analog voltage signals are sampled in registers, never stored directly in DB.
• 12-Byte Little-Endian Heart Rate Notification Packet (Dispatched at 1 Hz, Protocol Version 0x01)
• Parsed in volatile memory by BlePacket.dart & gated through SignalQualityFilter (SQI ≥ 60)
Transient RF payload — once parsed and gated, valid fields are stored into `samples` table.
3. On-Device ML Model Weights Asset (Static JSON)
• Path: app/assets/ml/model_meta.json & ml/models/weights.json (Compiled Asset, NOT in DB)
• Architecture: Tiny MLP 5 → 16 → 8 → 1 (Exact Count: 216 weights + 25 biases = 241 parameters)
Pure Dart isolate execution (< 0.15 ms); inferences are recorded into `ai_results` table.
• Generated on-demand by PdfReportGenerator using PDF/Printing libraries into device app storage
• Aggregates `sessions`, `session_stats`, and `ai_results` into self-contained printable vector PDF
Stored as standalone binary .pdf files on disk, NOT as database BLOBs.
• Hardware & BLE streaming: ESP32-C3 sends 12-byte packets → Phone BLE layer parses in RAM.
• Data ingestion: Gated samples (SQI ≥ 60) are inserted row-by-row into `samples` table.
• Session closure: 11 summary features computed into `session_stats` within atomic transaction.
• ML execution: Dart Isolate reads `model_meta.json`, classifies pattern → stores in `ai_results`.
• Zero Cloud: 100% of telemetry, statistics, and configuration remain within local SQLite database.
parsed in memory → stored as samples
ai_results — On-device tiny neural network inferences
• All child tables enforce ON DELETE CASCADE with foreign keys ON.
• Deleting a session atomically removes samples, stats, and AI results.
• Standalone settings have zero foreign key relationships.
